rows.note: Use this as the default colloquial expression when voracity refers to eating a lot or having an unusually strong appetite.

example.english: Eating so much shows real voracity.
example.traditional: 食咁多嘢，真係好有大胃口。
example.jyutping: sik6 gam3 do1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 daai6 wai6 hau2

rows.note: Use this for voracity as rapacity or greedy desire, especially toward wealth, power, or possessions.

example.english: His voracity for power is shocking.
example.traditional: 他對權力的貪婪，令人側目。
example.jyutping: taa1 deoi3 kyun4 lik6 dik1 taam1 laam4 ling6 jan4 zak1 muk6
